bio: Indulge in one of Britain’s most loved traditions with Afternoon Tea in the warming surrounds of The Kings Arms at Egham, Surrey.  A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  Why not book your own private Afternoon Tea party, hosted in the characterful surroundings of the garden room, The Menagerie, the restaurant spaces or private dining room, The Courtroom. The menu includes the highest quality, seasonal, farm to table ingredients packed into traditional Afternoon Tea delights.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday from 12pm - 5pm and bookings must be made at least three days in advance.
